Drop-In leaflet & leaflet.extras Compatibility Layer

Source: R/zzz_leaflet_compat.R
leaflet_compat.Rd

Provides 100% camelCase function and option aliases (leaflet(), addTiles(), addProviderTiles(), addMarkers(), addAwesomeMarkers(), addCircleMarkers(), addLabelOnlyMarkers(), addPolygons(), addPolylines(), addCircles(), addRectangles(), addRasterImage(), addLegend(), addLayersControl(), addMiniMap(), addMeasure(), addGraticule(), addSimpleGraticule(), addTerminator(), addDrawToolbar(), addSearchOSM(), setView(), fitBounds(), flyTo(), flyToBounds(), setMaxBounds(), showGroup(), hideGroup(), clearGroup(), clearShapes(), clearMarkers(), clearControls(), leafletOutput(), renderLeaflet(), leafletProxy(), providers) so existing R leaflet scripts, R Markdown / Quarto documents, and Shiny applications can run on glmap's C++17 + WebGL2 GPU engine with zero or minimal code changes.

Usage

leaflet(
  data = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  padding = 0,
  options = list(),
  elementId = NULL,
  sizingPolicy = NULL,
  ...
)

leafletOptions(...)

providers

addTiles(
  map,
  urlTemplate = NULL,
  attribution = NULL,
  layerId = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  options = list()
)

addProviderTiles(map, provider, layerId = NULL, group = NULL, options = list())

Arguments

data

Optional spatial dataset (sf, sfc, SpatRaster, data.frame, matrix, or SharedData).

width, height

Optional widget dimensions.

padding

Optional viewport padding in pixels.

options

Optional widget or layer options list.

elementId

Optional HTML element ID.

sizingPolicy

Optional htmlwidgets sizing policy.

...

Additional arguments passed to the underlying glmap function.

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

urlTemplate

Optional custom XYZ tile URL template (e.g., "https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png").

attribution

Optional attribution HTML string.

layerId, layer_id

Optional layer identifier.

group

Optional layer group name.

provider

Provider name from gl_providers.

lng, lon, lat, lng1, lat1, lng2, lat2, bbox, zoom, pitch, bearing, duration
